title: Cost Metric Lineage Explorer
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will examine a 19-node lineage graph to identify every downstream node affected when one source, table, or metric changes, for six change scenarios, matching the affected set exactly.

learningObjectives: The learner will examine a 19-node lineage graph to identify every downstream node affected when one source, table, or metric changes, for six change scenarios, matching the affected set exactly.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) A change in one source affects only the metric named after it. (2) A change to a price table affects every dashboard. (3) A change to a metric definition changes the data underneath it.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of six scenarios the learner selects the nodes they believe are affected and commits the selection before the answer is shown. A selection is correct when it equals the "Affected nodes" set in Content exactly, with no missing and no extra nodes. Mastery is 5 of 6 scenarios correct on the first attempt. Clicking nodes to read their descriptions is exploration, not evidence.
